# AstryxTheme { #anylumino.AstryxTheme }

```python
AstryxTheme(
    children=None,
    *,
    brand=None,
    color_mode='light',
    mode=None,
    direction='vertical',
    gap=2,
    **props,
)
```

Apply a reusable Astryx theme to child widgets.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default      |
|------------|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| children   | ChildInput                  | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `None`       |
| brand      | Mapping\[str, Any\] \| None | Reusable Astryx theme descriptor created by :func:`AstryxBrand` or :func:`AstryxBuiltTheme`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`       |
| color_mode | str                         | Astryx ``Theme`` mode for this component or subtree. Use ``"light"``, ``"dark"``, or ``"system"``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `'light'`    |
| mode       | str \| None                 | Alias for ``color_mode`` matching the Astryx ``Theme`` prop name. When provided, it takes precedence over ``color_mode``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `None`       |
| direction  | str                         | Layout direction.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `'vertical'` |
| gap        | int \| float                | Astryx spacing step between children.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `2`          |
| **props    | Any                         | Additional JSON-safe Stack props for the theme wrapper. Useful keys: hAlign, vAlign, justify, align, width, height, padding, paddingInline, paddingBlock, isScrollable, wrap, as, className, and style. Use brand and color_mode for theme identity; do not pass theme tokens through props. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Stack>. | `{}`         |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

This wrapper propagates theme descriptors to nested Astryx child widgets
because each anywidget renders in its own frontend root.
